name: Steamed Tender Green Beans (Fork-Soft)
whyItWorks: Green beans are low-FODMAP and safe for most IBD patients when cooked thoroughly. Steaming breaks down the outer cellulose pod, rendering them soft and non-bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Snap off woody stem ends and steam for 10–12 minutes until tender and easily pierced with a fork. Avoid al dente or crunchy snap beans during flare-ups.
watchOuts: Never eat raw or undercooked crunchy green beans during active inflammation.
